units.source_text: 可是，我既不能喝酒，也不能抽菸，從早到晚，

en.t: But I could neither drink alcohol nor smoke, and from morning until night,

units.source_text: 只是窩在二樓三張榻榻米大的房間，在被窩裡翻閱舊雜誌，

en.t: I merely holed up in the three-tatami room on the second floor, lying under the bedding and leafing through old magazines,

units.source_text: 過著白痴一樣的生活，連自殺的氣力都被磨損殆盡了。

en.t: living like an idiot, until even the strength to kill myself had been worn away completely.

units.source_text: 比目魚的家位於大久保醫專附近，招牌上的字「書畫古董商·青龍園」雖然赫然醒目，

en.t: Flounder's house was near the Okubo medical college, and although the sign reading "Dealer in Calligraphy, Paintings, and Antiques: Seiryuen" stood out boldly,

units.source_text: 也不過是一棟兩戶中的其中一戶，店門口狹窄逼仄，店內塵埃遍佈，

en.t: it was nothing more than one half of a two-unit building, with a cramped storefront and an interior covered in dust,

units.source_text: 堆放著很多破爛（其實比目魚並不是靠買賣這些破爛賺錢的，

en.t: piled with all sorts of junk. In fact, Flounder did not make his money by buying and selling this junk,

units.source_text: 而好像是將某位老闆的珍藏品轉讓給另一位老闆，從中賺取差價）。

en.t: but seemed instead to earn a margin by transferring one wealthy patron's prized possessions to another wealthy patron.
